message: Projects can be reused and paused. Save a project as a template, with its dates counted from its deadline or trip, or start a fresh copy with every task open again. Pause a project until a date to hold all of its tasks, repeating ones included, until then. When dating a task in a project, pick "1 week" or "2 weeks" before its deadline or departure, and moving the deadline offers to move the dated tasks with it. A project's page shows when it was last worked on, with a link to its history in the Logbook, which can now be filtered by project. A repeating task no longer keeps the rest of its project out of Pull from projects.
